page.overview:
Who is Ammit?

Ammit is a monster summoned by Shadi during his Shadow Games, in the Toei Yu-Gi-Oh! anime. This is the series incarnation of Ammit, from the Yu-Gi-Oh! manga.

Shadi transformed Curator Kanekura's chair into an illusion of Ammit, during a Weighing of the Heart Game of Darkness. After Kanekura failed the game's trial, he was rendered unconscious by Ammit.
